context: A daughter-in-law tends to her elderly mother-in-law
purpose: Care attentively; teach そろそろ/当初/おっしゃる/前後/かける/させる/ひどい

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お義母さん、そろそろお茶にしましょうか。
lines.en: Mother, shall we have tea soon?
lines.style: considerate daughter-in-law offering a break, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、当初からあなたは気がきくわね。
lines.en: Yes, from the start you have been thoughtful.
lines.style: fond grandmother praising her warmly, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 先生がおっしゃる通り、休息も大事ですね。
lines.en: As the doctor says, rest is important too.
lines.style: caring relative citing the doctor’s advice

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 医者がそうおっしゃるなら従うわ。
lines.en: If the doctor says so, I will follow.
lines.style: agreeable grandmother deferring to advice, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 前後の家事は私がやりますから。
lines.en: I will do the chores before and after.
lines.style: devoted daughter-in-law offering help, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いつも手間をかけるわね、ありがとう。
lines.en: You always go to such trouble, thank you.
lines.style: grateful grandmother appreciating the care, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: とんでもない。無理させるつもりはないんです。
lines.en: Not at all. I do not mean to overwork you.
lines.style: humble daughter-in-law downplaying effort, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔はひどい腰痛でね、当初は歩けなかった。
lines.en: I had terrible back pain; at first I could not walk.
lines.style: reminiscing grandmother recalling hard times, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それはひどい。今はお元気で何よりです。
lines.en: That is awful. I am glad you are well now.
lines.style: sympathetic daughter-in-law expressing relief, tone holding steady through the whole line
